items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution. Authorize no discretionary spend, budget commitments, monetization expansion, forecasts, requeues, or new production work. Revenue evidence supports only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI usage is currently recorded as $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26, conflicting with prior records of $963.5690377 and 5,390 calls; reconcile before final reporting. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned, period-aligned domain/infrastructure/labor/marketing/experiment costs are absent, incremental outcomes are not isolated, and monthly limits are blank. Clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, ordered items, shipped items, technical scores, and proposal counts are not financial return. Minimum measurement: reconcile the AI ledger, produce a dated period-aligned cost ledger by site/content/work item, preserve provider aggregate revenue as unattributed, measure incremental attributable commission against controls or pre-change baselines, and record owner-approved spending limits. Continue only existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded evidence work.

Retain the current attribution boundary. The 2026-09-21 Amazon result is aggregate provider revenue, not site revenue: $4.92 commission cannot be allocated to any property, while named site rows show $0 commission. Do not claim revenue, margin, ROI, payback, causal lift, cost-to-learn, infrastructure efficiency, or budget headroom from the available telemetry. Existing AI spend is an expense signal only; it cannot be compared with the one-day revenue window. Continue source-dated reconciliation using existing telemetry without duplicate instrumentation or new spend.

Retain containment without requeue. The 197 approved proposals lacking execution, 46 open failure follow-ups, 29 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and only 1 proven outcome are control and throughput signals, not evidence of financial return. Existing work may continue only within its documented scope and without discretionary spend or monetization expansion. Security-sensitive releases and rights-dependent monetization remain financially unapproved while infrastructure, attribution, source-rights, privacy, accuracy, and measurement evidence are incomplete.
